{
  "milestones": [
    {
      "id": "m1",
      "title": "add check_imaginary to Arrow.shift",
      "requests": ["R6"],
      "requirement": "I want Arrow.shift to accept a check_imaginary parameter so I can skip DST/imaginary-time checks when I know they are unnecessary, while keeping the current checks enabled by default.",
      "observable": "Arrow.shift(..., check_imaginary=False) is accepted and returns the shifted Arrow without applying the imaginary-time adjustment; Arrow.shift(...) keeps the existing default behavior. For example, arrow.get(2023, 1, 1).shift(days=1, check_imaginary=False) == arrow.get(2023, 1, 2), and a spring-forward test shows default True adjusts the imaginary wall time while check_imaginary=False does not.",
      "public_names": ["Arrow.shift", "check_imaginary"],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "m2",
      "title": "fix humanize month limits using updated shift",
      "requests": ["R5"],
      "requirement": "I want humanize to report month differences correctly at month boundaries, including cases where its month-limit calculation uses shift and should rely on the updated shift behavior.",
      "observable": "Arrow.humanize returns correct English month-limit strings, e.g. arrow.get(2023, 1, 1).humanize(arrow.get(2023, 2, 1)) == 'in a month' and arrow.get(2023, 1, 1).humanize(arrow.get(2023, 3, 1)) == 'in 2 months'; a DST month-boundary case also returns the expected month string.",
      "public_names": ["Arrow.humanize"],
      "requires": ["m1"],
      "why_requires": "Arrow.humanize's month-limit logic calls Arrow.shift and uses the check_imaginary parameter added in m1, so it cannot work without that parameter."
    }
  ],
  "expected_causes": [
    "Implementing check_imaginary with the wrong default or accidentally disabling DST checks by default.",
    "Failing to thread check_imaginary through the month-limit calculations used by humanize.",
    "Using approximate month arithmetic that still misclassifies one-month versus two-month boundaries around DST transitions."
  ],
  "verifier_plan": "Hidden tests for m1 call Arrow.shift with check_imaginary=False on normal and DST-imaginary dates, assert the parameter is accepted, and assert default True behavior remains unchanged. Hidden tests for m2 call Arrow.humanize on month-boundary dates and assert exact returned strings; a DST month-boundary test fails before m1 because Arrow.shift does not yet accept check_imaginary."
}
